family.description: This entry, previously known as DUF778, represents RTE1 (REVERSION-TO-ETHYLENE SENSITIVITY1) from Arabidopsis thaliana. RTE1 is positive regulator of the ETR1 ethylene receptor, leading to negative regulation of ethylene responses.[[cite:PUB00092499],[cite:PUB00092500]]. This entry also includes Arabidopsis RTE1 homologue, RTH, which acts via RTE1 in regulating ethylene responses and signaling [[cite:PUB00092501]]. This domain is also present in TMEM222 from animals which in humans plays a role in brain development and function and mutations result in autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder. This domain has been identified as structurally similar to peptidase C97 domain ([pfam:PF05903]).
family.name: RTE1-like
